title: 1,2,4-Oxadiazolyl phenoxyacetic acid-modified algae-derived biochar for efficient o-nitrophenol removal: adsorption performance and mechanistic insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18802-18815
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01348A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Eman M. Abd El-Monaem, Ibtehal Mohamed, Faisal Mohammed Alkahtani, Mohammed Salah Ayoup
A novel efficient adsorbent was engineered by supporting 2-(2-(3-phenyl-1,2,4-oxadiazol-5-yl)phenoxy)acetic acid (POPA) on algae-derived biochar (A-BC) for adsorbing o-NP (o-nitrophenol) from wastewater.
